scenes.en: Meena thought it was just age.
scenes.say: Meena's eyes kept watering all day. She thought it was just age.

scenes.en: Dry eyes can cause watering! Irritation triggers floods of thin tears.
scenes.say: Did you know? A common cause is dry eye. When the eye surface gets dry and irritated, it makes a flood of watery tears that don't protect it well.

scenes.en: Tears drain through a tiny duct into the nose. With age it can narrow.
scenes.say: Another cause: tears drain through a tiny duct into the nose. With age, this duct can narrow or get blocked, so tears spill over.

scenes.en: With age, lids can sag or turn, so tears don't drain well.
scenes.say: And with age, the eyelids can become loose, or turn slightly in or out, so tears don't flow where they should.

scenes.en: Wipe gently with a clean tissue. Blink often. Keep fan air off your face.
scenes.say: Meanwhile, wipe gently with a clean tissue, blink often, and keep fan or AC air off your face.

scenes.en: Pain, redness or swelling near the nose, pus, or blurred vision.
scenes.ta: வலி, வீக்கம், சீழ் இருந்தால் உடனே மருத்துவரை பாருங்கள்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if there's pain, redness or swelling near the nose, pus, or blurred vision.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for the elders at home.
scenes.say: Meena's daughter booked an eye test, and the cause was found. Book one for the elders in your home too.
